defs.def: a person whose job is to take care of sick or injured people, usually in a hospital 护士

ex.s: On the other side of my bed curtain, I heard a patient cheerfully  18  every nurse as they entered the room, as if welcoming each into his home.
ex.t: 在我的床帘另一边，我听到一位病人愉快地18 每一位进来的护士，仿佛欢迎她们来到他的家中。

ex.s: Jennifer Mauer has needed more willpower than the typical college student to pursue her goal of earning a nursing degree.
ex.t: Jennifer Mauer比典型的大学生更需要意志力来追求她获得护理学位的目标。

ex.s: She decided to go back to college to advance her career and to be able to better support her family while doing something she loves: nursing.
ex.t: 她决定回到大学深造，以推进自己的事业，并在从事自己热爱的工作——护理——的同时，更好地支撑家庭。

ex.s: To learn from the best nurses.
She wants to be a nurse.
Similarly, anthropomorphized products could be created to take on stereotype-inconsistent roles — a male robot that assists with nursing or a female robot that helps do calculations, for instance.
ex.t: 同样，可以创造拟人化的产品来承担与刻板印象不一致的角色——例如，一个协助护理的男性机器人，或一个帮助计算的女性机器人。

ex.s: I speak with the on-duty nurse, who tells me that Lara's parents rushed her to the hospital after she fell off her bicycle.
ex.t: 我和值班护士交谈，她告诉我劳拉的父母在她从自行车上摔下来后急忙把她送到了医院。

ex.s: Although it's the doctors and nurses who will treat her injury，it's my job to make her feel better.
ex.t: 虽然是医生和护士治疗她的伤势，但我的工作让她感觉更好。

ex.s: Although the doctors and nurses did a great job, hospitals weren't really designed for children.
ex.t: 尽管医生和护士做得很好，但医院实际上并不是为孩子设计的。

ex.s: More than 10,000 doctors and nurses came to provide medical care.
ex.t: 一万多名医生和护士前来提供医疗服务。

ex.s: We have to be very sensitive and work closely with the doctors and nurses, who keep us updated on each patient.
ex.t: 我们必须非常敏感，并与医生和护士密切合作，他们随时向我们报告每个病人的最新情况。

defs.def: (in the past) a woman or girl whose job was to take care of babies or small children in their own homes （旧时雇主家中的）女保育员，保母，女仆
to care for sb who is ill/sick or injured 看护，照料（病人或伤者）
to take care of an injury or illness 调治，调养（伤病）
to have a strong feeling or idea in your mind for a long time 怀抱；怀有；心藏
to give special care or attention to sb/sth 培育；培养；悉心照料
to hold sb/sth carefully in your arms or close to your body 搂抱；小心抱着
to feed a baby with milk from the breast 妇女或雌性动物
to suck milk from its mother's breast 婴儿
